Now gains the first two extra levels of life.

Details.PreRequisites: Members  must  not  be  outlawed  and  incapable  of  summoning  any  form  of  Undead  or  demon-kind  (creatures originating  from  planes  of  evil,  unnaturally  powered,  and  usually  ‘irrevocably’  evil  without  chance  of redemption), except by the use of scrolls & items, the use of which will be strongly discouraged.
Details.Ethos: Everyone, regardless of their racial or professional background is entitled to support and security. However, the creators of  Undead  and daemonkind, responsible for so much of the  unnecessary suffering in  Labyrinthia, and known for their use of unwilling sacrifices, should be re-educated. Undead, especially the mindless creations, and daemonkind  themselves  should  be  pitied  rather  than  reviled,  and  every  effort  spent  to  release  them  from  their bondage thus allowing them to either continue their journey in peace or return to their rightful plane. Controlling of these creatures is viewed as acceptable only if it is the most efficient method of removing them.
Details.Restrictions:
It is expected that the spirit of the guild restrictions are adhered to, not just the letter:
The 'wilful' killing of living creatures from this world or any other should be regarded as a last resort and to attack a truly defenceless creature, unless that creature is Undead or similarly irrevocably evil, without due compassion is to be avoided.
Similarly, members are discouraged from 'wilfully' striking any helpless target unless that creature is  Undead or similarly irrevocably evil or still posing a threat. Any member that does so of their own volition without due cause will suffer a perm -2 pt curse of conscience to which Immunity to Curses does not apply.
Guild members will be ready to lend aid and assistance to their fellow members. Any disagreements should be resolved as peaceably as possible and never with bloodshed. To wilfully attack another fully sworn guild member will result in the offender being struck from the roles and a perm -2pt curse of conscience to which Immunity to Curses  does  not  apply  (These  curses  will  stack  with  each  other  should  multiple  offences  be  committed  by  the same guild member).

Overrides.Effect: May use both innates at the same time to act as a mantic warding (the gold spell) vs one supernatural evil creature.

May use all three innates at the same time to act as a Hand of Banishment style effect which specifically only works on supernatural evil creatures which could in general terms affect the user – so an Elf could not banish a Wight – but a human could. If this ability is successful then they suffer 10TBLP per resistance level that the creature had.

Details.PreRequisites: Elves, Half elves, faeries, draves, half draves, drowe and half drowe may all join freely. Any other spiritless creature may join with the guild heads permission.
Details.Ethos:
The Children of the Dusk are a gathering of peoples and creatures who primarily originate from the magical world, however all share the lack of a spirit. We have all come together to aid one another, whether it be through having

an item made, having a friend on a mercenary mission or simply to share a mutual goal of gaining power and strengthening our magical sources.
Details.Restrictions: Generally speaking members must try to strengthen the guild and hold up to its ethos. Working to weaken magic/the dragons/sources of power will have you cast out of the guild. Depending on the severity of your actions this may happen immediately at the refs discretion.

Overrides.Effect: May expend “X” mana of racial innates (max 24) to cure a guild member (not self) X TBLP/Loc damage.
May expend “X” mana of racial innates (max 24) to cure a guild member (including self) X TBLP/Loc damage.
The first time the guild member would die on TBLP they may instead fall unconscious and gain a stacking magical only live to minus 12 TBLP. To use this costs them 6 mana of racial innates.

Details.PreRequisites: Must be an Amlesian race/class. Upon entry the character must decide upon their clan (Dragon, Crane, or other clan that is a member). This must be written on card upon entry. Members cannot belong to a Clan that is not part of the council (e.g. Panama or Snake)
Details.Ethos: Having tired of the almost lawless squabbling of the Clans, both Great and Low, the Dragon, Crane and Snake Clans came together with joint effort to form the Council of Jade, a coalition that is now a force for Law and Order in the Jade Empire. The Council acts as a place for the clans meet and train together and share techniques for the betterment of all. The Council works for the betterment of life in the Jade Empire for all that live there and fights tirelessly to keep the lands safe for its inhabitants. After recent events the Ox and Lion clans have joined and the Snake Clan has departed the council.
Details.Restrictions:
No member of the Council of Jade may be outlawed, if they become so they no longer gain any benefits until the crime is resolved at which time they may appeal to the Council for full membership again (only by the Guild Sire’s approval).

Unified Council - No member may attack or bring purposeful harm to another member, should this come to be they lose all benefits until the incident is resolved at which time they may appeal to the Council for full membership again (only by the Guild Sire’s approval). Any disagreements will be civilly dealt with by the Leaders of the Council; their decision is final in every case. The only exception in this rule will be cases of Seppuku. All cases of this restriction can be judged and dealt with by the Council Leaders in the same fashion as the outlaw restriction

Once Clan always Clan - Once you have joined the Council you may never leave unless expelled by a unified vote of the council (rebirthing releases you also).

Overrides.Effect: The member may now choose to be well equipped with apprentice crafted armour and a Journeyman crafted weapon as the basic tier, or a suit of journeyman crafted armour, or a journeyman crafted weapon.

Details.PreRequisites: Be a non-evil dwarf, not outlawed or ostracised - evil dwarfs may join with the Thane’s permission provided this is discussed first, and they are not chaotic in alignment. Duregars cannot under any circumstances join this guild (no exceptions). Werewolves regardless of race may be considered for lay membership due to the history between these races and the support, understanding and pacts which have been formed in the past. (As an OOC note – Werewolves DO NOT gain guild benefits).
Details.Ethos: To defend the Clan and its members and allies. We protect our home, families and each other. The Clan comes first, by working as one, we bring prosperity to all.
Details.Restrictions:
For the people: The people come first, we are the guardians and protectors above all. To bring destruction or wilful harm to the people will result in immediate and unequivocal exile from the clan, resulting in being ostracised when dealing with dwarves only.

For the clan: The clan home is always important and second only to the people. Wilful betrayal of the clan will result in exile as above.

A guild member that has been outlawed by the seers for party killing may remain with the Thane's permission.

Overrides.Name: The Clan Defenders (Life)
Overrides.Effect: When a member of the guild is unconscious or incapacitated, gains +6/2 life. This lasts 5 minutes or until the threat is resolved, even if the guild member becomes active again.

Overrides.Name: The Clan Defenders (War Cry)
Overrides.Effect: When a member of the guild is unconscious or incapacitated, gains an innate War Cry. This lasts 5 minutes or until the threat is resolved, even if the guild member becomes active again.

Details.PreRequisites:
Must be a non-outlawed character prepared to work towards the greater good of all planes of existence and those in need. The greater good relates to the continuance of our existence, accepting that Primus does not exist in isolation, and that the bearing of other worlds impacts our own for good or ill, and often requires our intervention. A member of the Highborn Assembly should be prepared to lay down their lives in order to achieve the safety of all.

No evil characters, Undead or demons - Whilst this guild does not specifically discriminate against such individuals, so long as they continue to act in ways such that they defend Primus, its people and beyond, it is less likely that such individuals are able to adhere to the self-sacrificing and heroic nature of this organisation. Exceptions surely exist, but in the interests of keeping the Highborn Assembly as one that stands apart from others this restriction is now in place.
Details.Ethos:
Primus sits at the centre of a tumultuous universe, with the power flowing through the Throne of Glass drawing the attention of multiple planes of existence for good and ill. History has shown many races seeking refuge here, and many other creatures seeking to control or destroy us. For our own part, we have ventured beyond our world to help others or defeat our enemies with strength and purpose for generations.

The Highborn Assembly seek to protect those that need it, regardless of place or even plane of origin. We do not exist in isolation; the death of another world impacts upon our own.

Details.PreRequisites: Must be a member of, or retainer to House D’treal. Other individuals can join by completing a guild special (or other relevant dungeon) to the satisfaction of the Guild head or Head of House.
Details.Ethos: The Guild is dedicated to the strengthening of the Empire of Glass, and through it House D’treal itself. Members are expected to respect the ancient pacts and patrons the House has amassed over time, while embracing the modern world and the House’s place within the Empire.
Details.Restrictions: Those individuals with legal issues with the Empire (Outlaw, Wolfshead, Ostracised etc.) can only remain a member with the Guild Heads permission. Individuals found to be acting against House D’treal or the Empire may be cast out of the guild by the Guild Head, and cannot re-join without the guild heads permission.

Details.PreRequisites: Have some skeletons in your closet! No fascist goodly types except Reast. We know your type and you’ll be turned away. If in doubt, turn up, be judged. Goodly people must be signed in to join.
Details.Ethos: The charismatic face of a bunch of lowdown, scum of the earth types with a penchant for robbing tombs, breaking skulls and casual murder. Whereas more upstanding guilds are in it for clan or country, or “defending the land”, or similar weak, easily subverted ideals, there’s none of that nonsense in the Society. People are in the Society because they want power or riches or a place to hide from whatever dirt is in their past. And frankly it’s much easier to be the one giving out the beats if you have a bunch of other nasty pieces of work at your back. Sometimes the Society works for other people but mostly it works for itself, capitalising on opportunities members might find.
Details.Restrictions:
Only available to people interested in the myth of Khaniabhad, sharing tales of the city if they have briefly managed to see it, hopeful of meeting a Khazak or just wanting to emulate a notorious Denizen!

No middlers. Contribute or get kicked out.

Being part of this Society is a criminal offence in the eyes of the Confederecy. This doesn’t result in outlawhood or ostracism, but it does come up on relevant criminal discerns.

Overrides.Name: We're in this together
Overrides.Effect: Acts as per war cry but can be used on other guild members at 20ft range.

Details.PreRequisites: Open to any non-evil individual. Evil individuals must complete a guild special to the satisfaction of the guild master before being allowed to join.
Details.Ethos: Formed in Farrels Fall the Knights began their quest following in the footsteps of a ghostly wandering knight. He lead them on a great quest that revealed the hidden secrets of an ancient order of knights attuned to the spirits of light and the elements. The Knight Errants have taken up the quest of ensuring the Demonic masters called the Dark remain imprisoned and that the deeds of the four champions are not forgotten.
Details.Restrictions:
Never Act without reason – All things should be done with purpose and intention. Everything has a value, but not always a price – All things hold value to someone, and this should be considered when acting. However just because something holds value does not mean it can be traded or have a price set to it.

If there has been a wrong, there can be no peace – The core of the heroisim for the order. Where they find wrongs have been done they will not rest until they have been righted, or those responsible dealt with.

Overrides.Effect: Acts as per a discipline innate. Never act without reason now lasts the full 5 minutes.

Details.PreRequisites: In joining the knights you swear a vow never to attack another member of the guild. Should you break this vow, accidentally or otherwise, the Lord Knight or a majority vote of Lords of Orders can cast you out of the guild for treachery – thus it can be very important to be sure who you are hitting in the dark! It is rare that Tribal creatures can join as they normally cannot understand / keep to the vow. If they are able to and are willing to then they may join the Knights of the Land.
Details.Ethos:
The Knights exist to protect the Land, now commonly referred to as Primus, and its people. In order to better function as an order, the Knights treat one another as brothers, seeking at all times to protect and nurture our fellows. This, however, does not hold more importance than the fundamental reason for our existence – the

protection of the Land and its people. No cause, whether religious or political, can take precedence over this. Thus, whilst anyone is welcome to join the Knights, there will always be those whose views and (more importantly) activities are not compatible. It is not, for example, fitting behaviour for a Knight of the Land to sacrifice innocent peasants to dark gods. Furthermore, the Knight’s brotherhood is not a hiding place for those who seek only safety for themselves.
Details.Restrictions:
• You must not harm knights directly or indirectly and are required to help each other to the extent of sharing all equipment during an adventure, acting honourably and without treachery at any time.
• A knight will never hide his membership as it is a thing to be proud of.
• Anyone ostracised, outlawed or Wolfshead in any place (Empire, Amles, Ishma, Baronies etc) must have the current Lord Knight’s permission to join – or remain a knight (must be signed on to character card).
• Any individual who is completely immune to comms/info effects must be signed in/have their membership of the Order’s countersigned by the current Lord Knight, Lord Unity, or Lord Seeker.
• Members are no longer cast out for striking a Knight, only willing killing them.
• Treachery is defined as working against another Knight, or the oath.
• No level or points are earned from an adventure if a fellow knight is left behind on an adventure, dead or alive. If this does happen then the Lord Knight and the GSM must be notified by the referee. They will then discuss if this warrants casting out or not.
• It should be clear that once a Knight of the Land has been ‘cast out’ for whatever reason they may not rejoin the guild.
• At the beginning of each adventure each knight must announce their presence by clearly and audibly affirming their oath: “Shield on arm, sword in hand, Brothers together, we defend the land” Failure to perform as above may result in the knight being ~ cast out ~ as detailed below:
• They may never again be Immune to Fear.
• All previous Knight of the Land abilities are applied in reverse.
• Any knight cast out for cowardice will never be able to use a sword or shield again. Cowardice involves leaving another Knight of the Land behind on an adventure (alive or dead)
• Any Knight who refused aid to another Knight or is cast out for for acts of treason will never again be able to use strength in combat.
• Any Knight cast out for acts of treason also suffers -6 max. AC to attacks to their back, from surprise or from range. The Lord Knight has decreed that those outlawed for party-killing may not remain members of the guild. The only circumstances in which there may be clemency are if the killing occurred in defence of a Knight of the Land, even self. If you believe this to be the case for you, speak to the Lord Knight quickly, as unless your guild membership is countersigned by the Lord Knight or the Game System Manager you may not adventure while a party-killing outlaw and a Knight. When an individual is cast out for whatever reason, the Lord Knight may choose to apply none, any or all of the “punishments” as he/she deems fit. The Lord Knight can be removed by a majority decision of the Lords of Orders, if they deem him/her unfit. This does not mean the Lord Knight is cast out, just that they are not fit for the job. The Lord Unity will act as Lord Knight until a new Lord Knight is elected. The Lord Unity/Voice must begin the election process again.

Details.PreRequisites: Be a Non-Evil Barbarian. This is a tribe.
Details.Ethos:
The Lo-Thi have many traditions and codes they follow closely and are thus almost always Lawful in their nature, rarely chaotic and never fickle.
Their dislike of the Empire however means they have little respect for its laws.
Apart from the one "Stalker" or Tribal Assassin the tribe have never been dark of heart.

Overrides.Effect: Owl’s Wisdom is now a full major prayer.

Details.PreRequisites: Must be a tribal creature, those that have buy as tribal somehow but are not tribal must get one of the guild heads permission to join.
Details.Ethos: We are here to give all the tribes a place to be safe and grow, May also be a member of established tribes and still join, and work to regain lands to the north as our own homelands away from Imperial rule.
Details.Restrictions: May not be a member of a pro Imperial guild. We are tribal’s – that’s enough.

Details.PreRequisites: While open to all mercenaries, those with legal problems (Ostracised/Outlawed/Wolfshead) must have guild masters permission to join/remain a member. This open membership does not affect or apply to classes/races etc who are not permitted to join social guilds (or limited to those they can belong to).
Details.Ethos: While some gather to further a great cause, others to serve the Empire, and the most famous to protect the land, The Order of Mercenaries is formed to aid its members when conducting their daily business; adventuring. Members are expected to help each other out while on adventure together. This doesn’t have to mean giving equipment away but in general they should work together as a unified mercenary company.
Details.Restrictions: If a member kills another member the guild master may cast the individual from the guild, resulting in them being unable to join/benefit from a social guild for a year.
Details.The Mercenary Way – Guild Status:
Junior Mercenary - Stage one: Cost 50 Table 1
While on dungeon with at least two other member of the guild life gained from OoM is increased by 3/1.
Mercenary Defence can be used as a Discipline innate, instead of a War cry.

Experienced Mercenary - Stage two: Cost + 75 Table 5
Mercenary Problems (not solutions) may now to be used on “items” to determine what they do.
Gains a Second innate of Mercenaries Unite

Jaded Mercenary - Stage three: Cost +125 Table 8
Gains a second innate Mercenary Defence.
Can now take each option from Strength in Numbers twice (guild members permitting).

Overrides.Name: Mercenaries Defence
Overrides.Effect: Acts as per War Cry, but only applies to the effect it was used against not for 5 minutes.
+6/2 life
Mercenaries Defence now grants immunity to the stopping effect for 30 seconds.
Strength in numbers now grants + 1 DAC or + 1 PAC if on dungeon with another guild member claiming guild benefits. If on dungeon with two other guild members claiming guild benefits gains both.

Overrides.Name: Mercenaries Unite!
Overrides.Effect: Can use a published self only beneficial ability on another willing guild member within 5ft. This could include a war cry, a cast spell, or similar.
Gains One of the following per other guild member claiming guild benefits on dungeon. Can only take each option once: +1 DAC, + 1 PAC, + 1 MAC, + 1 SAC.
+9/3 life
Mercenaries Defence now acts as per a full war cry.

Details.PreRequisites: Must be a Lawful Amlesian character class, or character with Amlesian background. Non-humans may join if intelligent (able to follow law). May not belong to another Amlesian Clan. Oni are not permitted to join, or be associated with this clan, and must leave if somehow a member.
Details.Restrictions:
• Must always be Lawful of alignment.
• No insult which the offending person refuses to apologise for will ever go unavenged.
• Anyone who breaks one of these codes must report to the clan head for execution.
• No member may refuse to report to the clan head, by any means whatsoever.
• Must follow the code of the family's honour. If on adventure with guild Master failing to do so to their satisfaction means they may require execution as above. If not on adventure, character may refuse to report for execution on these grounds, in which case they are cast from the Clan as a Ronin, and may never use Forearm Parry, nor more than one mastery in a weapon. All members of Panama immediately recognise such a Ronin on sight unless the Ronin is immune to physical, magical and spiritual informational effects, and disguised.
• No contracts may be sought by any member of the clan without the authorisation of the guildmaster.
• May not become immune to the guilds disbenefits (as is true for any guild disbenefits – if you choose to join a guild you accept their disadvantages).
• In order to leave the guild in ANY fashion must have guild leaders permission to do so which must be signed on character card. If this is not done then becomes a Ronin as above. Note: Woodrow Panama has Spirit Link to all Panama members, and others loyal to the Jade Empire. If you die you are free to contact him and inform him.

Overrides.Name: Forearm Parry
Overrides.Effect:
This skill allows the Monk to parry weapons with his hands and forearms taking no damage from the blow. It is not possible to parry a blow from a weapon without a Physical component. Effects attached to weapon blows are still taken – for example a Knock Back effect.
Note: That the Monk must be able to freely move his arms to use this skill. This skill cannot be used whilst using a 2 handed weapon, and may only be learnt at 8th level.
Forearm, Foreleg and Upper Arm Parries cannot ever be used in conjunction with a shield. A weapon that can be used as B-class, such as a bastard sword, or a spear, still prevents the use of Forearm/Foreleg/Upper Arm Parry even when held in one hand.
Attained at 8th level, and only if the character is a Warrior Subclass.
This ability allows the character to take only half damage from a Neuronic attack. It does not affect any non-damaging neuronic attacks.

Overrides.Name: Cold rage
Overrides.Effect: This ability allows the character to enter a Rage – such that for the next 5 minutes, the Warrior takes 25% less from any damage suffered – bar that suffered from purely magic weapons and magical spells. In a Cold Rage the Warrior is able to distinguish friend from foe and as such is not required to attack them. In a Cold Rage you may use ‘offensive powers’ such as Knock Back, but not other powers like Monk Locational Healing or using your magical ring to Blink away.

Overrides.Name: Panama
Overrides.Effect: This ability allows the Warrior to negate one listed stopping effect, and grants immunity to that effect for the following five minutes. It must be used within 2 seconds of the effect occurring and accompanied with a loud shout.

Details.PreRequisites: Be a Goblin or Hobgoblin.
Details.Ethos: Spider tribe goblins were once renowned for cowardice, however the prevailing side of their goblin instinct has switched. They are now nasty, stabby, sneaky lovers of ambushes (and cowards....).
Details.Restrictions:
May only ever attack from a position of perceived strength; in most cases this will mean a helpless opponent, attacking from behind, or outnumbering the enemy.

May not leave the tribe without the permission of the chieftain.

Details.PreRequisites: Be a Goblin (or Hobgoblin).
Details.Ethos: The Gargoyles are a small tribe of Goblins with ancestral lands (or turf) in the Eartholme underworld. Well-adjusted to the underbelly of city life, the Gargoyles run racquets, and protection for and from the peons of Eartholme. Careful to stay beneath the notice of the D’Treals the Gargoyles follow a long established set of rules that are intended to keep them safe and keep them rich.
Details.Restrictions:
Snitches get murdered. You don’t squeal on The Tribe, on pain of death.
Once you have made a deal (for money) you hold up your end of the deal.
You don’t kill other members of the Eartholme families (or mercenaries) without the families (or the laws) consent. If you get black-balled (or outlawed) you are a problem for The Tribe.
You don’t kill peons at random, these folks pay the bills. You murder a bunch and the D’Treals notice. If they notice you become a problem for The Tribe.
The Tribe deals with its problems.

Details.PreRequisites: 1st class mana using classes with Sorcery as a 1st colour may join. Other classes that have access to Sorcery spells may join with permission from the guild sire.
Details.Ethos: For too long the art of Sorcery has been considered lesser to wizards. We have less magical power, we have to beg the dragons to make our spells work on the noble bastard axe and we are precluded from many of the expert trainings of the pure wizard. No more. Come and learn why every second wizard these days has traded away their expertise to learn the sorcerous arts...

Details.PreRequisites: Be a Ratfolk.
Details.Ethos:
The Swarm is a group of rats from all clans and breeds who for one reason or another have gathered together under the banner of Slavik, treating its nine tails and teachings as a totem to be respected and worshipped in their many rat ways - trying to make their mark in the world of humankind.

The tribe (for that's what it undoubtedly is) is made up of rural nomadic rats, a mix of those pro-Thimon, and also those who do not find or accept the sewers of Thimon as the fitting "city" that they were promised.

They roam Labyrinthia gathering strength and numbers from pockets of isolated rats, offering them protection and the feeling of the swarm - for every child of Slavik knows safety is best found in numbers.

It is through this understanding, and network of contacts, rather than gathering in the open under a large banner, or other such shows of force that these few become the many, the powerless the powerful - this is the strength and power of the Swarm.

Details.PreRequisites: Be an armour wearing, weapon wielding, pro-imperial priest.
Details.Ethos:
The Rosarian faith is a curious anomaly. A monastic faith without a divine figurehead, comprised of warrior-ascetics and a laity drawn mostly from soldiers, both retired and serving. It is a soldier's faith, a warrior-cult, devoted to the Empire, at its core built on twin pillars of belief; one is vitae, and the other is karmic reincarnation.

They believe in fate as a concept, both accepting it and acknowledging that they can improve their next life by facing it. Rosarians refer to fate as The Source Of All Things; where a Michaelean might say 'If St. Michael wills it', a Rosarian would say 'If the Source wills it' to mean 'if it is my fate'.

To Rosarians the notion that serving the Empire well, and overcoming adversity to do this, means a better station in the next life; the ultimate goal is to achieve a form of enlightenment the Rosarians call Vorder, where the spirit sheds the mortal realm and moves on to the spirit world, where they can guide members of the faith. It is these spirits the Rosarians channel in a quasi-shamanistic fashion to perform miracles and question for knowledge.
Details.Restrictions: Wear black. Wear armour and carry weapons; there are no Rosarian armoured or pure priests. Fight, but try not to get hit; parrying is better than using healing. Try to be calm, frugal and efficient, and avoid rages. Try to be as self-sufficient as possible.

Details.PreRequisites: Players who took part in the 2024 extended length, Ice Touched Souls, or those who subsequently have the permission of the Guild Head.
Details.Ethos: Working towards the health, security and wellbeing of a newly hatched Dragon located in the Far North and its symbiosis with the land while also assisting the Far North in its efforts to remain free from subduction, demonic entities who intend harm to the area, and to ensure the Great Freedom is enforced and encouraged regardless of race, creed, or background.
Details.Restrictions: Demonic, Outlawed and Ostracised players must seek permission of the Guild Head prior to join this guild (excluding those who took part in the extended length). Any characters fundamentally opposed to the Far North are also prohibited from joining.
Details.Guild Motto: Wash your own stuff, or die!

Details.PreRequisites: This guild is primarily for Yeomenry or those with similar rebirth-related abilities, but anyone can join.
Details.Ethos:
The Weave Has Many Threads - Understand that there are innumerable paths to walk; in different lives you have walked different paths. In one life you may walk the same path as those you currently oppose.

Understanding is Not Condoning - Look to understand the motivation behind those who act against you. You should endeavour to recognise which parts of this are born of choice, necessity or circumstance.

Find The Astray - People wander away from society. Some do so to find their true path, while others do so because the world has failed them. Give both a guiding hand.

Do Not Become Lost - Walk the path set for you, without concern for seeming erratic, odd, or bizarre.

In many ways an anti-social social guild, the Lost and the Found are a bunch of misfits and hermits that usually try to keep a mostly perfunctory relationship with the rest of creation. They started off as Yeomenry keeping abreast of relationships that spanned lifetimes, literally, with members keeping tabs on each other as they returned from death with fresh outlooks as well as their old ones.

Far more likely to advise a chosen hero than take on the mantle themselves, they find themselves called in equal parts to hide away in shacks on the edges of civilization and to wander in vast crowds.

Details.PreRequisites: Any who seek knowledge are welcome to join, but no-one who is outlawed for party killing may join or remain a member of Who knows? without the direct permission of the guild master.
Details.Ethos:
In the realm of the unknown, we thrive, seekers of mysteries. We are the guild Who knows? - a collective mind, in pursuit of the secrets we are destined to find. The guild encapsulates the spirit of exploration, the value of knowledge, the strength of unity, and respect for diversity, which are all key elements for a guild that prides itself on delving into the unknown and seeking answers.

Our members vary from an ogre chef who wants to find the ultimate recipe, to scholars, librarians, puzzle masters and ritualists.

Details.PreRequisites: Be goodly aligned and not an Undead or Demonkind. Guild membership must be signed on by the guild head. May not be an existing member of an imperial organisation/guild such as the Department of Collections & Recoveries or an Imperial Legion, nor join one without the express permission of the guild head.
Details.Ethos:
The White Wind is a small and select group of mercenaries dedicated to the furtherment of good as and where they are needed. Willing to go bravely into the darkness and seek to triumph for the forces of light. Many members possess faith or wield powers of light but not being dedicated to a power or wielding such does not preclude one from joining their ranks.

Members of The White Wind are expected to support each other and work together to vanquish evil and strengthen to power of the Heavens.
Details.Restrictions:
All members are expected to carry their guild marker with them on all mercenary missions.

No guild member may return or aid in the return of an evil being to life, the only exception being those who are redeemed at the point of their resurrection (OOC definition: No to anyone who remains evilly aligned).

A member of The White Wind that knowingly leaves behind another member be they unconscious or dead where they or their body was retrievable receives no points for the adventure.

No guild member is able to deceive or interfere with communications by guild members although being protected from communications is not an issue.

Any member that is “Black Marked” by their own actions has their membership immediately suspended and cannot claim guild benefits until the Guild Sire has reviewed the situation and countersigned their membership once more.

The Guild Sire may de-list any member he believes has not acted or does not act in the true spirit of The White Wind and need not be on adventure to do so.

Overrides.Name: Ward against Sin
Overrides.Effect: Declared as per a war cry and lasts for 5 minutes gains + 1 M AC, + 1 SAC, and + 1 Level of Resistance vs effects from someone evil, or that by their nature are evil ( i.e. evil miracles).

Overrides.Name: Ward against Sin
Overrides.Effect: Gains a second Ward against Sin innate, and can use both at the same time.
Gains a second The White Ribbon innate.

Overrides.Name: Ward against Sin
Overrides.Effect: Gains a 3rd Ward against Sin innate; can use all 3 at the same time if desired.
Gains a 3rd The White Ribbon innate.

Details.Ethos: The Lingists follow the Ling Chan the teachings of Tsu-Ling, Oceanic god of Peace and Tranquillity. They believe in promoting the cause of peace and aiding the lives of the common folk of Primus, protecting them from the ravages of war.
Details.Restrictions:
• May never use rages.
• May only attack in self defence.
• Suffers Item restrictions as Paladin.
• May only kill living creatures as a last resort.

City Benefits.Name: The Citadel
Effects: Mercenaries hired by the city council have their standard potion allowance paid for.

Overrides.Effect: These innates may now be used to destroy Undead up to 6th level or demons up to 8th level (still costing 6 TBLP per dismiss/resistance level of the creature destroyed)

Local System Effects: Where in all other places and cities one would find vermin in the form of Rats virtually none can be found in Deci, in their stead that ecological niche has once more been taken by serpents of all types including venomous although Deci locals are quite adept at avoiding the dangers these could pose to the unwary.

City Benefits.Name: The Beggar's Banquet
Effects: The Beggar’s Banquet in Cheapside grants all Deci Beggars (both Kallah and Hanot) the CP Benefits of Haven, Home and Blinkered Eye in Deci.

City Benefits.Name: The Serpent's Shadow
Effects: Local System Effect active until the end of 2026: Black spells cast in Deci count as being 1 mana less than usual to a minimum of 1 mana. This affects both casting level and mana cost of black spells cast with free mana. Cannot be used for learning spells. This can be used by anyone casting a black spell, even if cast as a specialist. This does not stack with any other form of reduction, including Expertise

City Benefits.Name: The King’s Largesse
Effects: Mercenaries hired by or acting on behalf of Deci, the Deci Council, Anath, Troy or the City Sprit have their potion allowance covered.

Mercenaries hired by, or acting on behalf of, Deci, the Deci Council, Anath, Troy or the City Sprit have their pay increased by 1,000Grulls per mercenary (which the referee may claim from the Desk for paying a party).

Where a mission has been sanctioned by Anath, King Troy, the City Spirit or the Deci Council for the benefit of Deci then an additional World Point is generated for use by the Referee that can only be applied to the direct benefit of Deci (i.e. adjust a Deci city stat positively).  (Referee Note:To claim this additional WP quote PCLD290 on the Debrief sheet alongside the extra WP).

Overrides.Name: Gains a second Holy Word dismissal as paladin
Overrides.Effect: Gains a second Holy Word dismissal as paladin.

City Benefits.Name: Halgar Inner City Wards
Effects: Whilst in the inner city of Halgar it is not possible to use any supernatural power that is not neuronic in nature (Divine Guidance or similar applies). Additionally, any ongoing supernatural effect, other than elven animances / similar, ends upon entering. Any cast within are likewise dispelled. This is a published dispelling effect.

City Benefits.Name: The Citadel
Effects: Mercenaries hired directly by the Rodanne City Council have their standard potion allowance paid for.

Overrides.Name: Gains a second innate Discipline
Overrides.Effect: Gains a second innate Discipline.

Overrides.Name: Discipline
Overrides.Effect: If Discipline is already owned, gains a third Discipline innate.

City Benefits.Name: Scarlene Summonation
Effects: The Scarlene City Spirit has a spirit link (and true kin) to the city’s Hanot and Kallah and is aware if they die.  It is able to summon their bodies/spirits to try and resurrect them.  PC Scarlene beggars may choose, when they die or within the next hour, to have their body summoned (an OOC choice) – shifted as per Word of Recall. Unless the city spirit is unable to restore them itself, this counts as an on-dungeon res. Character cards need to be left at the desk in an envelope for Christine Gentry.

City Benefits.Name: The Citadel
Effects: Mercenaries hired directly by the Sellaville City Council have their standard potion allowance paid for and the council can pay an additional 1,000 grulls for a mercenary hire.

Overrides.Name: Gains a second Absorb Disease innate
Overrides.Effect: Gains a second Absorb Disease innate. The life will stack with itself, to a max of 12/4.

Overrides.Name: Gains a third Absorb Disease innate
Overrides.Effect: Gains a third Absorb Disease innate.

Overrides.Name: Gains a 2nd Invoke the Ghoulstone innate
Overrides.Effect: Gains a 2nd Invoke the Ghoulstone innate.

Overrides.Name: Gains a 2nd Invoke the Wraithtree innate
Overrides.Effect: Gains a 2nd Invoke the Wraithtree innate.

City Benefits.Name: Khanibad’s Assassin Guild
Effects: Guild members do not belong to any of the cults within the city, or other factions within it. Indeed their independence is perhaps the only thing that allows them to remain active.
Their only rules are they will honour contracts taken, will not endanger the secrecy of the city, and will remain loyal to their own guild.
Available to: This replaces a published scout status and is available to 1st Class Assassins and Kallah from Khaniabad, or 1st class scouts who have multi-classed to Assassin or Kallah from Khanibad.

Details.Restrictions: Lose clan benefits...

Overrides.Name: Gains a second Blood Sacrifice innate
Overrides.Effect: Gains a second Blood Sacrifice innate. If uses both at the same time (including loss of 24 TBLP) can cast any standard evocation or evil miracle, or any standard elemental (not white) spell.

Overrides.Name: Gains a third Blood Sacrifice innate, and they may now also be used to cast Onyx, Bronze, and Ebony spells (still within level limit)
Overrides.Effect: Gains a third Blood Sacrifice innate, and they may now also be used to cast Onyx, Bronze, and Ebony spells (still within level limit).
With the chosen protectee: gains danger sense for threats to the master.
With the chosen protectee: gains Take Killing Blow for the master (at master's resistances, and must be used at the time).

City Benefits.Name: The Citadel
Effects: Mercenaries hired directly by the Mordred’s Rest City Council have their standard potion allowance paid for and the council can pay an additional 1,000 grulls for a mercenary hire.

Details.PreRequisites: Human only. Evil alignment only. Must be one of the approved Owil'Rha'Tha classes.
Details.Ethos: The Owil'Rha'Tha ancestral faith is a dark totemic tradition rooted in clan loyalty, grievance, and necromantic practice.
Details.Restrictions: Priest-class members may not join another church. Their ancestral faith counts as their church and cannot be left without excommunication.

Details.PreRequisites: Any non-outlawed Evil Character in the Priest bracket may join, along with Unholy Champions who are not outlawed.
Details.Ethos:
The Crimson Reverence believes Vampires to be the highest form of existence — eternal beings freed from the weakness, fear, and decay of mortal life. To walk in darkness is not corruption, but transcendence.

Its followers do not seek dominion over the undead, but service to them. Blood freely given is sacred, and to nourish the children of night is considered a holy act. Members are taught never to raise a hand against Vampiric beings except in unavoidable self-defence, and many would sooner die willingly than destroy one they revere.

The Church survives in the shadows of the Empire, small in number and feared by many. Yet the faithful endure, united by the belief that mortal kingdoms fade, while the blood of the eternal dead will outlast them all.

For the living perish.
For the dead endure.
For the blood is eternal.
Details.Restrictions:
No member shall reveal the identities, sanctums, or dealings of the Blooded to outsiders. Betrayal is punishable by death (conditioned heart stop, which can be activated by the high priest at any time).

No member may act against a Vampiric patron, sacred undead, or ordained leader of the Reverence except in immediate self-defence.

The will of the High Reverent and those they appoint is absolute within the Church. Open defiance is heresy.

No member may bring hunters, templars, or agents of the law upon the Church through recklessness, vanity, or loose speech.

The secrets, rites, and blood-sacraments of the Reverence are never to be shared beyond the faithful.

Any member judged to endanger the Church, its masters, or its sanctuaries shall be cast out and offered to the night.

Overrides.Effect: The successful use of a level drain or a double level drain (including from 'Song of Blood') now causes the user to regain 3 spirits.
The successful use of a level drain or a double level drain (including from 'Song of Blood') causes the user to regain 3 spirits. Gains 2 additional innates

Details.PreRequisites: The guild is open to all, but see restrictions below.
Details.Ethos:
We are mercenaries bound together through shared experience, not a creed or crown just the belief that we can make a difference.

We hold no debts between us, for what one of us has, all of us may call upon. Strength freely given returns in its own time.

Our permitted beliefs are wide and sometimes they may clash, but loyalty outweighs doctrine. Not every one of us needs every other, yet each of us is needed by someone in this family, and that need alone grants the right to belong.

While not unknown, we are not commonly linked with the aristocracy and find most of our allies / members among the common people (smiths, priests, farmers, shop keepers, tavern owners, labors, etc.) that the guild itself champions.
Details.Restrictions:
No demon-kind or undead may join without the guild head or deputy's permission (must be signed onto card).
May not willingly attack another member except in self defence.
Should always aim to help each other as if family and not try and further one’s own religious or political agenda to another’s detriment.
A guild member should always do what is reasonably within their power to prevent the death of fellow members. If they do die, they should do what is reasonably within their power to resurrect them.
Guild members should never lend money to each other at a profit. If a guild member can craft items, they should not charge guild mates more than the cost to make them.
Guild members will be ready to lend aid and assistance to their fellow members. Any disagreements should be resolved as peaceably as possible and never with bloodshed. The killing of another guild member will result in banishment from the guild.

Overrides.Name: 1st Stamina
Overrides.Effect: Grants 1st stamina.

fires-of-the-banner.Effect: Grants +2 MAC vs one colour of magic (chosen at start of day by each individual taking this benefit). Requires at least one guild member on dungeon to be in the wizard bracket.

Details.PreRequisites:
Must choose 'Drinker' or 'Maker' upon entry to the guild, which must be signed onto the character's card.
Drinkers become mildly addicted to potions; as such they must drink at least 6 doses of beneficial potion (of any type) each section or lose a level of resistance until a good night's sleep is had.
Makers require at least 6 skill levels in a potion making skill.
Details.Ethos: The Apothecary Society is a business project created by Asher & Xanion designed to gather potion makers and drinkers. A place for those with a potion habit.
